provenance.populationRule: Cards tagged main-set are collector positions; a record with side 'b' is excluded because back faces share the front face's physical collector position.

evidence.caveat: These are exact censuses and deterministic text/stat proxies over printed cards. They do not establish gameplay strength, draft pick quality, archetype viability, fun, or human outcomes.

mainCards.description: Main-set collector positions, with double-faced back faces excluded so one physical card is one observation.

nonlandCards.description: Main-set collector positions whose type line is not a land; basic and nonbasic lands are excluded.

creatures.description: Main-set collector positions whose type line includes Creature, including artifact and multicolor creatures.

manaValuedNonlands.description: Nonland main-set collector positions carrying a numeric current mana value in the pinned source.

numericCreatures.description: Creature collector positions with integer printed power and toughness and a numeric current mana value.

rareMythicNonlands.description: Rare or mythic nonland main-set collector positions eligible for the static bomb-risk warning proxy.

commonUncommonNonlands.description: Common or uncommon nonland main-set collector positions eligible for the static weak-card warning proxy.

complexity.methodology: Current Oracle word count, nonempty rules-text lines, explicit keyword occurrences, and decision-marker terms are separate static workload proxies; none measures actual board-state complexity.

denominator.description: Expected physical card slots in one weighted Draft Booster from the pinned collation recipe.

mechanicAsFan.methodology: For each booster variant, sheet slot count is multiplied by variant weight and each card UUID sheet weight; a card contributes once to every printed keyword or ability-word label it carries.

denominator.description: Main-set collector positions whose type line is not a land; basic and nonbasic lands are excluded.

archetypeSupport.methodology: For each two-color pair, counts exact two-color cards and monocolor cards in either color. This is a card-supply proxy, not evidence that the cards form a coherent or winning archetype.

denominator.description: Rare or mythic nonland main-set collector positions eligible for the static bomb-risk warning proxy.

bombRisk.methodology: Rare and mythic nonlands crossing the versioned multi-axis impact or efficient evasive-impact warning rule.

denominator.description: Common or uncommon nonland main-set collector positions eligible for the static weak-card warning proxy.

unplayableRisk.methodology: Common and uncommon nonlands crossing the versioned no rules text or keywords, expensive-low-impact, or low-stat-efficiency warning rule.

riskProxies.methodology: Versioned warning heuristics use current text features and printed stats. They deliberately label risk for later native simulation and human review; they never label a card proven bomb or unplayable.
